adaptation.description: Selected repository-authored directing rules, excerpted and condensed for both chat planning and video AI writing; no external scripts or reference libraries execute or load at runtime.

cinematic-director: Hard rules: story function, blocking before framing, one dominant move/action, end state, observable behavior, continuity invariants, request-sized output
Pipeline: beat meaning, blocking, motion-only/image reference and first/last-frame prompts, timed multi-shot prompts, sound layers
video-storyboard-gen: Structure: story setup, confrontation, resolution and removal of redundant shots
Continuity: identity, props, direction, exact complete time windows, dialogue duration and sound layers
AI video: real material references, consistent anchors, current model controls and no output guarantee

productAdjustments: Keep native generation, polling, saving and assembly; no copied community script workflow.
Apply motion budget to each continuous shot, allowing distinct timed shots in a supported multi-shot clip.
Do not require extra references, keyframe images, alternatives or additional paid clips for every request.
Preserve native speech tracks; do not import any silent-source-audio policy.
Exclude model lists, fixed duration/resolution specifications and named filmmaker style modules.

promptNotationReference.incorporation: Locally authored interoperability instructions. Official skill and reference files are linked, not redistributed; no MIT license is asserted for those official files.
